purpose: Source-level provenance for the archived Windows CE documentation already held in this repository. These records describe documentation evidence only; they do not grant reuse rights or establish an implementation surface.

records.applicability: Historical Windows CE 1.0 developer and driver documentation. Extracted material is documentation evidence, not redistribution permission or executable-source evidence.
known_limitations: Multimedia Viewer topic text has not yet been normalized.
CPU architecture and ABI applicability have not been determined from this source record.

records.applicability: Historical Windows CE 2.0 technical documentation and white papers. This medium does not contain the CE 2.0 SDK API reference.
known_limitations: The separate CE 2.0 SDK Books Online API-reference media is not represented by this record.
CPU architecture and ABI applicability have not been determined from this source record.

records.applicability: Official Windows CE 3.0 documentation archive; extracted HTML is searchable documentation evidence. Per-topic version applicability must be read from each topic's requirements information.
known_limitations: Archive-level scope does not establish a declaration, ABI, ordinal, or architecture for an individual API.
The generated HTML is an extraction of a CHM and should retain its connection to the original archive.

records.applicability: Emulator and remote-tools documentation for Windows CE .NET 4.2. It is not evidence for the complete CE .NET API reference.
known_limitations: The media is x86-emulator-only and does not establish device CPU ABI behavior.
No complete Windows CE .NET 4.x API-reference set is present on this media.

records.applicability: Official offline Windows CE 5.0 component documentation. Individual CHM pages must be examined for version, architecture, and API-specific requirements.
known_limitations: The retained collection excludes OS binaries, host tools, and emulator images.
Offline CHMs have not been normalized into per-topic source records.

records.applicability: DVD release-note evidence for Windows Embedded CE 6.0. It is explicitly not a complete API-reference source.
known_limitations: The DVD does not contain the complete CE 6.0 API-reference set.
CPU architecture and ABI applicability have not been determined from this source record.
